data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name 'Ariche', meaning 'ruler, strong one, little lioness'. In Greek mythology, the name Arica is associated with the goddess Artemis, the goddess of the hunt, wilderness, wild animals, the Moon, and chastity. The name Arica carries the meaning “Little Lioness” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Arica usually hope their child will grow to embody little lioness and live with faith, good character and purpose.

For Christians, Arica may serve as a reminder of the Divine Feminine and the strength and wisdom that it embodies.
